concerns.location: plan.md: Constitution Check, Principle VI row; Complexity Tracking rows 1-2
concerns.text: Plan openly deviates from Constitution VI MUSTs (FSL/AFNI execution; AAL/Schaefer parcellation) and from Constitution VII's expert-blind-rating dependent variable (halt path). The deviations are honestly flagged, but a per-project constitution is not amendable by a plan note — the plan should either cite a ratified constitution amendment/version bump or explicitly route these through the amendment procedure (open PR, Sync Impact Report), otherwise downstream constitution gates will fail the plan as written.

FR-012 requires the manifest to record 'all derived metrics, covariates, expert ratings, and statistical outcomes', and plan Phase 8 / data-model ManifestRow promise the same, but the schema defines only age, fd, skill_proxy_value, pc_1, fdr_p_primary and sets additionalProperties: false — instrument, genre, practice intensity, education, task condition, and other PC scores cannot be represented. Schema and plan/data-model disagree.

quickstart says download_openneuro.py writes data/raw/column_inventory.json, and Phase 0 depends on that inventory, but data-model.md's File Layout omits column_inventory.json (and qc_<subject>.json is listed but not described in Entities). Add it so the data model covers every artifact the plan produces.

mean_global_efficiency/modularity/participation_coefficient are required, but excluded subjects (excluded=true, per data-model 'Excluded subjects appear in the manifest') may have no computed metrics; the schema makes their rows invalid. Either make these optional for excluded rows or state how excluded subjects get metric values.
